test_title: PYST 43: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known acts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No Brush is Bed.

II. Some Table are Brush.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Table are not Bed.

II. All Bed are Table.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
Statements:

I. No Brush is Bed.

II. Some Table are Brush.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6183277443f481b04a19310bf7eb54116631730121e9b150f548361e2791451.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Table are not Bed. - **True **(because, No Brush is Bed and Some Table are Brush so which part of table intersect with brush will not be bed, it is definite)

II. All Bed are Table. - **False **(because, No Brush is Bed and Some Table are Brush so all bed ca never be table)

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion I follows".**
